thread:
ivy (sec-eng): Shotgun: vendor pen test scheduled for May 4. Need final decisions on RBAC, KMS access model, audit export cadence, and retest booking. Quick sync?
omar (infra): KMS proxy preferred. No direct CMK access for vendor. Proxy issues ephemeral session keys.
zack (eng-sre): Proxy TTL 1h by default. Will add pt:session tag for all calls so SIEM can filter.
jo (ops): For logs we'll push CloudTrail + LB logs to readroom S3, create presigned GETs rotating every 24h. Will script presign and log who downloads.
tess (legal): NDA must be signed and data handling attestation in place before any access. Retention: 90 days post-engagement unless approved longer. PII redaction required prior to handoff.
ivy (sec-eng): RBAC: short-lived role scoped to readroom S3 prefix, CloudWatch read, and invoke of proxy. Who takes IAM policy?
zack (eng-sre): I'll draft the IAM role and PR. Will include condition limiting by aws:RequestTag pt:session.
omar (infra): I'll build proxy and include example key policy that denies vendor account direct access. Use separate staging CMK for reproduction.
jo (ops): Proposed test windows: May 4 09:00-13:00 PT and May 7 12:00-16:00 PT. Dry-run May 3 staging 10:00-11:00 PT. OK?
ivy (sec-eng): Looks good. Runbook items: 1) NDA gate, 2) create presigned URLs, 3) deploy smoke-tested proxy, 4) SIEM pt:session filters, 5) retest windows confirmed. Volunteers?
zack (eng-sre): I'll own RBAC PR and SIEM queries.
omar (infra): Proxy and CMK separation on me.
jo (ops): I'll own presigned flow and calendar invites and verify NDA before issuing creds.
tess (legal): I'll confirm vendor NDAs and send data attestation template.
pt-bot: Ticket PT-4720 created: pen-test intake & access plan. Assigned: zack, omar, jo.
ivy (sec-eng): Thanks. Small request: enable CloudTrail insights for the readroom bucket during testing window and tag all alerts with pt:id=4720.
zack (eng-sre): Will add pt:id tagging in proxy wrapper and SIEM rule: pt:id="PT-4720". Adding a snippet in PR.
ivy (sec-eng): Great. Let's regroup tomorrow 10m after PR + runbook drafts. If anything blocks, call it out here. :thumbsup:
